comment: The Dark Project (upstream dead 2024-04): I.AI.getActivePackage() returns nil for actors with no active AI package; both helpers deref it unguarded, crashing twice per frame per NPC (~98k errors/session, visibly interrupting NPC movement). Guard added; find anchors on the enclosing function name so each patch applies exactly once.
replace:
is_following = function()
        local pkg = I.AI.getActivePackage()
        if not pkg then return false end -- MRI fixup: upstream nil-deref

in_combat = function(with)
        local pkg = I.AI.getActivePackage()
        if not pkg then return false end -- MRI fixup: upstream nil-deref

comment: OpenMW Farming: getEquipment(slot 16) is nil with empty hands; .recordId deref crashed onUpdate every frame (22k errors/session).

SME hit chance: types.Weapon.record(nil) when no weapon equipped — sol argument error every frame (10k/session). Skip display when unarmed/non-weapon, matching the mod's (never-supported) unarmed case minus the crash.
replace:
local carriedRight = types.Actor.getEquipment(self, types.Actor.EQUIPMENT_SLOT.CarriedRight) -- MRI fixup: nil-deref
        if not carriedRight or not types.Weapon.objectIsInstance(carriedRight) then return end
        local weaponType = types.Weapon.record(carriedRight).type

comment: OpenMW Dynamic Actors: when a dialogue starts with no other qualifying NPC within 2000 units, nearbyActors is built without .n and onUpdate dies every frame on a nil for-limit ("'for' limit must be a number", 3820 errors in the 2026-08-15 12:22 session). Initialize n = 0.
replace: nearbyActors = { wander = settings:get("unpause_wanderai"), n = 0 } -- MRI fixup: nil for-limit
